inference.spatial_affinity_formula: S_ij * exp(-d_ij^2/(2*sigma^2)); spatial_only uses G, spike uses S
inference.rgb_background_model: per-image border-patch RGB median and 1.4826*MAD (scale floor 4/255 intensity levels)
inference.spike_binary_definition: per-component crossing traces thresholded as components != 0 before the standard correlation product
